
This page contains a list of lujvo that I (Robin Powell) created programmatically.  All the lujvo listed here (that say "not found in database", at least) are those that are mentioned in the gismu or cmavo lists but don't have active definitions in jbovlaste.

If you make one of these words, it is polite to remove it here, but don't worry about it *too* much.

-Robin

Also, some of these lujvo are not actually in the canonical (lowest-scoring) form. Please check their canonicity with jvocuhadju or some such.

-Arnt Richard

'''{jvsv balzgibe'e}'''

bende bed     be'e crew                 ' band '

x1 is a crew/team/gang/squad/band of persons x2

directed/led by x3 organized for purpose x4

(x1 is a mass; x2 is a set completely specified);

~np~[also orchestra (= zgibe'e, '''balzgibe'e'''), outfit; x3

conductor; business, not necessarily incorporated (=

cajbe'e, venbe'e)]~/np~; (cf. gunma, girzu, dansu, jatna,

jitro, kagni, kamni, minde, ralju, cecmu, gidva)

'''{jvsv basysakta}'''

sakta sat          sugar                ' sucrose '

x1 is made of/contains/is a quantity of sugar ~np~[sweet

edible]~/np~ from source x2 of composition x3

~np~[also sucrose, fructose, glucose, galactose, lactose,

etc.; saccharine/aspartame/sugar substitute ('''basysakta'''

or sakybasti, ticysakta); x3: composition including

x3, which need not be complete specification]~/np~;

(cf. silna, titla)

'''{jvsv batygre}'''

batci bat          bite

x1 bites/pinches x2 on/at specific locus x3 with x4

~np~[bite through (= ka'arbatci, '''batygre'''); pinch (=

cinzybatci)]~/np~; (cf. denci, jgalu, guska, citka)

'''{jvsv bavla'ima'i}'''

masti         ma'i month

x1 is x2 months in duration (default is 1 month)

by month standard x3

~np~[this month (= cabma'i); next month (= '''bavla'ima'i''');

last month (= prula'ima'i)]~/np~; (cf. detri, djedi,

jeftu, nanca)

'''{jvsv bavlamcerni}'''

cerni cer          morning

x1 is a morning ~np~[dawn until after typical

start-of-work for locale]~/np~ of day x2 at location x3

~np~[this morning (= cabdeicerni); tomorrow morning

(= '''bavlamcerni'''); yesterday morning (= prulamcerni,

prulamdeicerni)]~/np~(cf. vanci, murse, tcika)

'''{jvsv bavlamcte}'''

nicte     cte      night

x1 is a nighttime of day x2 at location x3;

(adjective:) x1 is at night/nocturnal

~np~[tonight (= cabycte); tomorrow night (= '''bavlamcte''',

even when tonight is still in the future); last night

(= prulamcte)]~/np~; (cf. donri, djedi, tcika)

'''{jvsv bavlamna'a}'''

nanca         na'a year

x1 is x2 years in duration (default is 1 year)

by standard x3; (adjective:) x1 is annual

~np~[this year (= cabna'a); next year (= '''bavlamna'a'''); last

year (= prulamna'a)]~/np~; (cf. detri, djedi, jeftu, masti)

'''{jvsv be'ejda}'''

lijda     jda      religion

x1 is a religion of believers including x2 sharing

common beliefs/practices/tenets including x3

~np~[also mythos, creed, traditional beliefs,

x2 people(s), adherents; (adjective:) x1, x2,

x3 are religious/ecclesiastic in nature; x2 is a

believer in/of x1, an adherent/follower of x1 (=

seljda for reordered places); x2 is a practitioner

of x3 (= selterjda for reordered places); x3 is a

reordered places); priest/clerical (= jdaca'i,

krici, latna, malsi, marde, muslo, pruxi, ranmi,

'''{jvsv cirsau}'''

slabu         sau  familiar

x1 is old/familiar/well-known to observer x2 in

feature x3 (ka) by standard x4

not the opposite of ' young ' (= nalci'o, tolci'o),

but the opposite of 'new' (= tolni'o); also ancient

(= tcesau), age (= nilsau); x2 is used to x1 (=

selsau for reordered places); historic/historical (=

'''cirsau''', cirselcedra; also vaipru)]~/np~; (cf. clani, citno,

cnino, se djuno; not the opposite of citno, djuno)

'article'; however, 'determiner' includes all words

that can introduce a noun phrase/sumti, whether a

'article' typically refers only to a single word;
